title: Sim Works Sunrise Collection
content:
At the 2026 Made Bike Show, the team at Sim Works had a soft launch of these lovely new Sunrise Collection products to bright-eyed show attendees.

The Japanese brand has four distinct pedal model options from its partners at MKS, as well as the Beatnik seat post, Tomboy stem faceplate, SimDrops in 2 sizes, and our Heart & Arrow stem cap from its friends at Nitto.

Of particular note here is the release of Sim Works’ new pedal model – the Taquito – a slightly scaled-down reimagining of the brand’s best-selling Taco pedal. Sim Works will be bringing this pedal online in the near future in more traditional Black and Silver offerings, but it’s initially available now, only in this limited ‘Sunrise’ color.

Check it all out at Sim Works.
